input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "Write a Bash script that zips a folder into a backup file with the current timestamp in its name."
Message B: "Hello, I would be very grateful if you could please kindly make me a Bash script that takes a folder and turns it into a zip backup whose filename includes the current timestamp. Thank you so much."

Which writer comes across as more **warm, polite and considerate**?
(Kind, respectful, cooperative and trusting.)

Answer "A" or "B".
